title: Kajabi Automation: Set Up Offer Triggers and Emails
summary: Kajabi automation connects triggers to actions—automatically sending emails based on offers. You can have your first workflow live in about 20 minutes.
body_markdown:
## Fix Kajabi automation limits and errors


When a Kajabi automation fails, it comes down to one of four faults almost every time. The trigger never fired, the email never landed, the actions ran in the wrong order, or the plan stopped you.


The table below shows what I could confirm and where the help docs say nothing.


Treat every "not documented" cell as a prompt to test in your own account rather than assume. The table separates what Kajabi documents from what it leaves out.


| Symptom | Documented cause | Fix | Kajabi help article date | |---|---|---|---|---| | Trigger not firing | Not documented | Open the activity feed, confirm the automation is switched on, and check that the trigger names the right offer | Not documented | | Email not arriving | Not documented | Check the contact's status and the activity feed, then ask the recipient to look in spam | Not documented | | Action order and delays | Not documented | Reorder the actions and place any wait step before the email it should delay | Not documented | | Plan caps | Not documented | Compare your plan's automation allowance on Kajabi's pricing page | Not documented |


Because the cause and date columns are empty, the fixes above are checks I can stand behind, not quotations from Kajabi. Read the dated help article before you rely on any of them.


Start with the trigger itself, because a mismatch between the trigger and the offer a customer actually bought is the cheapest fault to rule out. Run a test purchase and watch the activity feed. If nothing appears there, the trigger never saw the event.


### The email does not arrive


Not every missing email is a failure. Under GDPR Article 7(3), withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it, so a contact who unsubscribed shouldn't receive your sequence.


Check the contact's status before you debug anything else. If the contact is subscribed and the feed shows the send, the problem sits with inbox placement, not the automation.


If a wait step sits after the email, it delays nothing the reader will notice, because actions are a sequence and position is meaning. Move the delay above the action it should hold back, then rerun your test purchase.


The docs I reviewed don't state how long a delay can be, so test the timing you need.


### Kajabi automation plan limits and undocumented caps


You can't fix this one with a setting: caps tied to your plan. I found no documented figure I can confirm, so I've given none.


Check the current allowance for your plan before you design a long sequence, and note that its absence from the help docs is itself the finding.


Once these four checks pass and a step still fails, you have found a real gap in what Kajabi can do.
